title: Register Babulus as a quota product
description: Follow-up to kanbus-c56402. Supply the Babulus role to AccountsPlaneOptions.quotaProducts with quota: true, grant the Babulus control plane role execute-api:Invoke on the three quota routes, and operator-grant the first allowance. Needs the owner's approval for the new IAM and a Prospectus coordination before any merge to main.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR opened registering babulus: accounts/babulus.ts (options validated, values from PROSPECTUS_BABULUS_* environment, none in Git), AccountsPlane 'babulus' option (product registration, account/authorize routes, five quota routes, no account creation), Anthus apps entry, specs and tests. Awaiting owner approval of the role and client values; not deployed.
